name: Hazar Enan
overview: Hazar Enan is identified in Scripture as a key geographical marker defining the northeast boundary of the Promised Land. Numbers 34:9-10 establishes it as the starting point for the east border, while Ezekiel 47:17 and 48:1 reaffirm its position near Damascus and Hamath, marking the northern extent of the tribal allotments. These passages emphasize God's precise and sovereign delineation of the land He promised to Israel, underscoring His faithfulness in providing a defined inheritance for His people.
